answer: A Verified email inbox bound by one-time code delivery with a public binding record ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. Auditors look for the lotus that does not belong: a channel with no owner behind it. The garden keeps the process honest and the wander keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
